short.text: Brent Grimes was a strong starter at corner for Jacksonville in 2013, playing in all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games in his one season with the club. The staff saw a technically sharp coverage corner with excellent short-area reactions, eyes and ball skills, at his best in off coverage and reading patterns. Size and strength, getting off blocks and run support were the less favorable parts of his game. He finished 2013 with {{2013.regular.tackles}} tackles, {{2013.regular.defensive_interceptions:words}} interceptions and {{2013.regular.passes_defended:words}} passes defended.

transactions.text: Signed a one-year, fully guaranteed contract with Jacksonville as a free agent
